Phobos orbits a terrestrial planet..why: Almost never stated: across all subjects, Dolma has 8 hits for 'orbits a terrestrial planet' (RedPajama 3), against 251 for 'Phobos orbits Mars' and 554 for 'Mars is a terrestrial planet'. Phobos co-occurs with 'terrestrial planet' about as often (254) as with the wrong class 'gas giant' (239), out of 260,115 mentions of Phobos, so co-occurrence is noise rather than statements; sampled hits describe Mars as terrestrial near a mention of its moons. Wikipedia's Phobos article never says terrestrial or rocky outside citation titles. It follows from Phobos orbiting Mars and Mars being terrestrial.
